def q1(label, q):
    try:
        d = sql(q)
        out(label)
        for r in d.itertuples(index=False):
            out('   ', *[x for x in r])
    except Exception as e:
        out(label, 'FAILED:', str(e)[:300])
q1('wrds_13f_holdings by report year: filers, rows', "select extract(year from rdate)::int y, count(distinct cik) f, count(*) n from wrdssec.wrds_13f_holdings where rdate >= '2009-12-31' group by 1 order by 1")
q1('wrds_13f_summary: filings by year of report and form type', "select extract(year from rdate)::int y, form, count(*) n from wrdssec.wrds_13f_summary where rdate >= '2009-12-31' group by 1,2 order by 1,2")
q1('wrds_13f_link rows, distinct cik, distinct mgrno', "select count(*), count(distinct cik), count(distinct mgrno) from wrdssec.wrds_13f_link")
q1('crsp.holdings range', "select min(report_dt), max(report_dt), count(distinct crsp_portno) from crsp.holdings where report_dt >= '2024-01-01'")
q1('firm_ratio: permnos in the last month', "select max(public_date), count(distinct permno) from wrdsapps_finratio.firm_ratio where public_date >= '2025-10-01'")
q1('JKP US rows in the last month', "select max(eom), count(*) from contrib_global_factor.global_factor where excntry='USA' and eom >= '2025-10-01'")
